''See also: [[Blackwatch Guild Head Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Blackwatch{{!}}Blackwatch Guild]] Head is the leader of the [[Blackwatch]], an imperial organization established by the Emperor to utilize and study the power of the [[Elders]] for the benefit of humanity. The current [[Guild]] Head is [[Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss]], a woman described as having pale hair and an unpredictable, intimidating presence. She possesses significant power, comparable to other major [[Guild Heads]], and is a [[Soulbound]]. [[Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss]] is known for her ability to bypass or ignore standard guild procedures, such as the formal application and interview processes, and she has demonstrated the [[Authority{{!}}authority]] to place members under her personal supervision or take individuals into custody. Within the guild, she is supported by [[Alsa Grayweather]], who serves as her second-in-command. The role of the [[Guild]] Head involves high-level interaction with other imperial leaders and managing a disciplined, regimented force of [[Watchmen]] who wear black uniforms adorned with the guild's crest: a nest of tentacles overlaid by six inhuman eyes. Historically, the position has been held by others, including a former leader named [[Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius]] who was once groomed for the role before an incident involving his face. In some instances, [[Guild Heads]] are elected based on their ability to bond with specific ancestral vessels.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Blackwatch{{!}}Blackwatch Guild]] Head is a terrifying young woman characterized by her long, silver-toned blond hair. She is typically seen wearing a long black coat adorned with silver buttons while she drinks tea. As the leader of her organization, she is known to issue various whims.}}
